action: Paints greys directly in Sculpt Mode with the Paint brush: dark hair and brows, white sclera.
tool: Sculpt Mode / Paint (color attribute)
why: black-and-white colour blocking straight on the sculpt
reader_equivalent: project_paint or bpy color attribute fill per object (hair dark grey, skin light grey, eye white)

action: Opens the Grease Pencil brush asset library in Draw Mode and picks the Ink Pen brush to draw lines over the sculpted face.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode / brush asset shelf / Ink Pen
why: ink linework (lashes, lid lines) for the black-and-white illustrated look
reader_equivalent: bpy: add a Grease Pencil object, set stroke placement to Surface, add strokes whose points are raycast onto the head mesh (no blender-live sculpt tool covers this)

action: Isolates the two eyeball spheres in local view and draws the iris/pupil ring lines on them with Ink Pen.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode / Ink Pen, Local view
why: draw iris outline directly on the eye surface without the lids in the way
reader_equivalent: bpy: local view of eye objects; grease pencil strokes as circles projected on the eyeball surface

action: Zooms out to check the ink lines on eyes and lids against the whole bust.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode, view navigation
why: judge line weight at reading distance
reader_equivalent: viewport screenshot via blender-live render/screenshot tool

action: Switches the Grease Pencil object to Edit Mode and selects/moves stroke points near the eye.
tool: Grease Pencil Edit Mode / Select Box, Move
why: reposition ink strokes after drawing
reader_equivalent: bpy: edit grease pencil stroke point coordinates

action: Uses Grease Pencil Vertex Paint mode with the Paint brush on the ink strokes.
tool: Grease Pencil Vertex Paint / Paint brush
why: tint/shade the ink strokes
reader_equivalent: bpy: set grease pencil point vertex_color

action: Back in Draw Mode, draws a lower-lid line under the eye with Ink Pen.
tool: Grease Pencil Draw Mode / Ink Pen
why: lower lash line

action: Edits Grease Pencil strokes in Edit Mode (move), then draws drip/tear lines under the eyes in Draw Mode.

action: Draws black drip lines from the mouth corners down the chin.

action: Adds an Opacity modifier to the Grease Pencil object and keeps drawing ink details, checking from a low angle.

action: Switches to Sculpt Mode on the head and uses the sculpt Paint brush (Paint Soft) to paint value on the face.

action: Selects the torso in Object Mode and opens its material (skin.001) whose surface is a Mix Shader with Color Ramp and Principled BSDF nodes; viewport switches to a shaded look.
